scope: Engine-level DFlash2 verification speedup for fafstmobel on one RTX 5090 (32 GB), third kernel pass. Round time is the controlled metric; tokens/s also depends on draft acceptance. The second- and third-pass changes are bit-exact, so 6b1c3fa and the new revision accept identical drafts; b4e8ed4 differs at 32K because the first pass changed attention numerics.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB; desktop GPU workloads active during measurement
model: fafstmobel NInfer v3 artifact; DFlash2 with 15 draft tokens; optimized proposal head (--lm-head-draft); K8V4 KV cache

revisions.third_pass: b2215c4 (with 0ddb836: bank-conflict-free Q4 proposal head, retuned small-token FP8 A8 tiles, GDN record convolution fused into its input projection, wider argmax, fused RMSNorm-SwiGLU FFN with pre-quantized NVFP4 projection inputs)

product_benchmark.tool: ninfer_bench --spec dflash2 --draft-tokens 15 --lm-head-draft --kv-dtype k8v4 --warmup 1 -r 2; greedy; 256 generated tokens
product_benchmark.protocol: the three binaries alternate for four runs (8K, 32K) or three runs (131K); median of runs
